database_description: This site is just a tool to update your database FILE. NO HOSTING. You must Save to keep your work.
database_save_error: Your latest changes could not be written to this browser's storage ({error}). Save your database to a file to keep them.
database_open_error: That file could not be read.
database_open_replace_confirm: Loading replaces the ENTIRE campaign database currently in this browser — every campaign and player. Continue?
database_load_error_title: Your database could not be opened
database_load_error_body: The database stored in this browser could not be read: {error}
database_load_error_save_first: Save what is stored to a file before starting over, so nothing is lost. Starting over (creating or loading a database) replaces it in this browser.
database_load_error_saved: Saved. You can start over now.
database_load_error_start_over_confirm: Remove the unreadable database from this browser and start over? Only the file you just saved keeps it.
database_load_error_unavailable: This browser's storage could not be read at all, so there is nothing to save yet. Reload the page to try again.
